categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Modifies test/functional/p2p_tx_download.py, which tests p2p transaction relay and download behavior.
categories.rationale: Fixes an intermittent failure in p2p_tx_download.py caused by nodes[1] lacking mocktime during test_block_inv. When wall-clock time advanced before nodes[0] delivered an announcement, nodes[1] requested from an unresponsive test peer and caused sync_mempools() to fail.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Per the category definition, fixes for tests of a specific area belong to that area rather than test infrastructure unless the root cause is in the framework machinery.
categories.rationale: The failure stems from missing mocktime in the specific p2p relay test script rather than a bug in the test framework or runner.
